name: gogi
displayName: Gōgi (合議) — coordinator, scout, monitor, dev, techlead, PO/BA, investigator
description: Delegates any engineering request to the right roles: a coordinator classifies intent (implement, fix-bug, investigate, review-code, review-pr, pr-comments, breakdown, explain) and runs that playbook with only the agents it needs. The coordinator only coordinates; a cheap scout seeds the run's knowledge hub first; a monitor owns the heartbeat and wakes the coordinator only with actionable events; every agent keeps a worklog and is rotated when its context outgrows a budget. Least code that works (a stop order every role walks before adding anything, a --lean level, an over-build review pass and a slim intent), agreement before code, an autonomy level (low | high | full), frozen-tree reviews, per-run knowledge hub + comms log + token stats, learned user preferences. Never pushes or opens a PR.
